name: Sealform
description: A disc with a band of radial notches round its edge.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 50%, transparent 50%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 12%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 50%, transparent 50%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 12%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
